    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate threshold
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter cannot be boolean")
    if not np.isscalar(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0 or not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite nonnegative scalar")
    
    # Validate matrices
    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, 'logp_with_result'), (logp_call_only, 'logp_call_only'), (logp_no_call, 'logp_no_call')]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.shape[0] == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} cannot be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    
    n, H = logp_with_result.shape
    
    # Compute weights
    t = np.arange(H)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()
    
    # Compute losses
    L_plus = -np.dot(logp_with_result, weights)
    L_call_only = -np.dot(logp_call_only, weights)
    L_empty = -np.dot(logp_no_call, weights)
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_empty, L_call_only)
    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    keep_mask = margin >= tau_filter
    
    return keep_mask, margin.astype(float)"}
